meta.name: baoyu-post-to-wechat
meta.description: Posts content to WeChat Official Account (微信公众号) via API or Chrome CDP. Supports article posting (文章) with HTML, markdown, or plain text input, and image-text posting (图文) with multiple images. Use when user mentions "发布公众号", "post to wechat", "微信公众号", or "图文/文章".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把内容自动发布到微信公众号
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要把文章或图文发布到微信公众号
copy.tagline_en: Automatically post content to WeChat Official Account
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently need to post articles or image-text to WeChat Official Account

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把你的内容发布到微信公众号草稿箱：支持图文（最多 9 图）和文章；文章接受 HTML、Markdown 或纯文本，并按流程转换、补全标题/摘要/封面后发送。
howto.when: 当你说「发布公众号」「post to wechat」「微信公众号」等词时触发。

say.text: 把 article.md 转成文章发布到公众号
say.note: Claude 会转换 Markdown 并发布为草稿。

say.text: 用 API 发布这篇文章，标题叫「周报」
say.note: 指定方法后直接走 API 发布。

say.text: 把这 5 张图发成公众号图文
say.note: 走浏览器图文流程，最多 9 张。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude publishes your content to a WeChat Official Account draft box. It supports image-text posts (up to 9 images) and articles; accepts HTML, Markdown, or plain text, converts and fills in title/summary/cover.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions "发布公众号", "post to wechat", "微信公众号", etc.

say_en.text: Turn article.md into an article and publish it to my WeChat account.
say_en.note: Claude converts Markdown and publishes it as a draft.

say_en.text: Publish this article via API with the title 'Weekly Report'.
say_en.note: Claude skips the method question and publishes via API.

say_en.text: Publish these 5 images as an image-text post to WeChat.
say_en.note: Uses the browser flow; up to 9 images allowed.
